description: Defines the MinidumpMemoryRange class, a derived class of MemoryRange with methods for handling minidump-specific data structures, including subrange extraction and ASCII string retrieval.

classes.name: MinidumpMemoryRange
classes.description: A subclass of MemoryRange with added methods for handling minidump data structures, such as subranges and ASCII string extraction.

methods.name: MinidumpMemoryRange
methods.description: Constructor initializing with data pointer and length.

methods.name: Subrange
methods.description: Returns a subrange of the memory, either as a MinidumpMemoryRange or empty if out of bounds.

methods.name: Subrange
methods.description: Returns a subrange based on MDLocationDescriptor, covering the specified RVA and size.

methods.name: GetAsciiMDString
methods.description: Extracts an ASCII string from the memory range at a given offset, assuming ASCII characters.
